No finite experiment substitutes for the analytic proof.

value.rationale: A global common shift reduces cost compared with independent per-cell randomization but correlates all node errors. For positive algebraic endpoint singularities, its RMS may be infinite even when integration is valid. This theorem determines the precise feasibility threshold, universal leading error, and the maximal gain available using only a second coupled global shift at matched 2m cost. These are motivated numerical design benchmarks rather than arbitrary parameter slices.
